facts.fact: Marcus 通知 Kai：与 Yna Martinez 会面确认 11:00 AM，地点她指定的咖啡馆
facts.anchor: Meeting with Yna Martinez confirmed for 11:00 AM

facts.fact: Yna 2:00 AM 交 Chapter 14 修改稿，附言先在纸上淌血才肯睡
facts.anchor: She sent them over at 2:00 AM, sir. Along with a note

facts.fact: 书连续 twenty-two 周畅销榜，读者忠诚近乎狂热，Kai 视为裹在混乱里的金矿
facts.anchor: Her books had stayed on the bestseller list for twenty-two consecutive weeks

facts.fact: Kai 发问：三年回避面对面，为何现在同意
facts.anchor: She's been dodging face-to-face meetings for three years. What changed?

facts.fact: 送学时 Lynne 为草莓果汁盒讨价还价，Michael 车道跳舞储备数学课能量
facts.anchor: I haven't finished my negotiation for the strawberry juice box!

facts.fact: 8:45 AM 完成送学（答应 Lynne 晚饭 tacos），回家淋浴化妆换奶油衬衫
facts.anchor: She checked her watch. 8:45 AM. School drop-off was done.

facts.fact: 提前到 Tim Hortons 占窗边角桌赶稿，距 Kai 到达约 ninety 分钟
facts.anchor: About ninety minutes left until Kai Rhodes would arrive.

facts.fact: 【转折】握手瞬间 Kai 认出她是昨晚酒吧森林绿毛衣女子=追签三年的作者，而她未认出他
facts.anchor: The woman from last night. The elusive, brilliant dark fantasy author
